text: Supersedes the DB bench part of 2026-11-25 note 1: the 2026-11-24 DB bench was prescribed at 75 lb, not 80. The week plan (filled 2026-11-22) said 80; the morning refill on 2026-11-24 under the new load rules (PR #23: an unlogged test set counts as 0 RIR, round down) gave 75, and the athlete did 75 as pushed. The change was not listed in the day record changes or the notification (gap). Chest-supported DB row: 25 lb x10 x3 was close to right; maybe slightly heavier possible, but the athlete was fatigued by then.
